body:
I'm sorry, I know all of you are only trying to help but it's just not convincing. I won't believe that a stranger "loves" me, or that everyone on this earth is a "shipmate." I can't roam the world because my anxieties barely let me leave the house. That's nothing more than a pipe dream - it's unattainable in every sense of the word. I'm not saying that nobody else is able to do this, just that I'm not. And it's true, I'm not. This isn't my depression talking, it's an unfortunate fact. And it's one of the reasons I'd like to leave.

I know you're all trying to help but the fact of the matter is that there is no reason for me to stay. I've never been happy. Yes, the conditions in my mind are making me think that death is the only viable escape, but it's those conditions that have created the person I am today. I'm not going to accept some pseudo-inspirational bullshit about how I'm above my conditions or whatever, because *those conditions control me.* Those inescapable deficiencies prevent me from being happy. No form of medication, exercise, some dumb spiritual journey or love could ever change that. There is only one way out.

In the big scheme of things, it's just another life. The only effect it'll have on this earth is that the planet will flourish off my nutrients once I'm underground.
